description.value: Kaslo Front Street Market is a family-owned and operated community grocery store in Kaslo, BC, serving locals for over a decade. It stocks fresh BC produce, Alberta beef, local Konig sausage, deli meats, cheeses, and a range of ready-to-eat items from the in-store deli and bakery. For touring cyclists passing through the Kootenays, it offers a well-rounded resupply stop in a small mountain town on Kootenay Lake.
